newsitem.title: UK: Pearson up as Laing repeats "buy" rating.
newsitem.headline: Pearson up as Laing repeats "buy" rating.

text.p: Shares in Pearson Plc firmed on Thursday as Credit Lyonnais Laing reiterated its "buy" recommendation, dealers said.
The shares also were buoyed by expectations of an upbeat lunch meeting the company is holding with brokerage BZW today, they said.
At 0919 GMT, Pearson shares were up 6-1/2p to 704-1/2 in a generally flat to weaker UK media sector. The FTSE 100, meanwhile, was off 25.0 points to 4,632.0.

In repeating his recommendation, Credit Lyonnais Laing analyst Nick Ward noted that the stock has underperformed and said he was looking for positive developments in the second half of the year. --London Newsroom +44 171 542 5106
